claims.text: The FDA label says acute and chronic alcohol intake may unpredictably strengthen or weaken glimepiride's glucose-lowering action.
claims.quote: Both acute and chronic alcohol intake may potentiate or weaken the glucose-lowering action of glimepiride in an unpredictable fashion.

claims.text: The FDA glimepiride label says hypoglycemia is more likely when alcohol is ingested.
claims.quote: Hypoglycemia is also more likely to occur when caloric intake is deficient, after severe or prolonged exercise, or when alcohol is ingested.

headline.text: The FDA label says alcohol can unpredictably strengthen or weaken glimepiride's glucose-lowering effect.

reported.text: The interaction section describes unpredictable changes with acute and chronic alcohol intake.
The warning section also identifies alcohol ingestion as a factor making hypoglycemia more likely.
